generation.metricsHint: Each step uses the provider-reported token usage and measured response timing. First output includes text, reasoning or tool calls. Output speed covers generation after the first output; end-to-end speed includes the initial wait. Missing metrics are omitted; short replies may not represent sustained speed.

storage.context: History keeps measurements, without individual request details.
storage.drawing: History does not retain the drawing or execution details.
storage.needle: History keeps measurements. The same sample ID and settings can recreate the test text.
storage.probe: History keeps the test summary, without request or response content.

probes.decision: Send a sample state to the decision endpoint and check for a decision value or probabilities.
probes.embedding: Send sample text and check the returned vector and its dimensions.
probes.image-generation: Send an image prompt, check the response and preview the generated image.
probes.models: Fetch model names and counts from the endpoint to choose models for further tests.
probes.rerank: Submit a query and candidate documents, then check their relevance ranking.
probes.structured-output: Ask the model for JSON containing ok: true, then validate the field value and structure.
probes.text-generation: Check whether the model follows a prompt. A reply containing OK passes, regardless of letter case.
probes.tool-calling: Ask the model to call the built-in timestamp tool. The test passes when that tool call is detected.
probes.video-generation: Submit a video generation task, wait for its status and inspect the generated video.
probes.web-search: Check whether the API can use web search and inspect the results and citations.

context.description: Uses the declared context length as the test cap, or up to 1M tokens when unknown. Each batch has about an 8M-token cumulative input budget and can resume after pausing.
context.discardWarning: Too many interrupted tests are saved. Discard inactive records to continue. Their charge status is unknown; running tests are kept.
context.emptyResponse: The response ended normally without answer text; input acceptance remains unconfirmed.
context.hint: Tests the input context length accepted by the endpoint. Results depend on the API and request configuration and do not establish the full context window.
context.historyError: History is unavailable. The current result is still shown.
context.incompleteResponse: No conclusive response was received. Finish reason: {{reason}}.
context.interrupted: The request was interrupted; its charge status is unknown. It was not retried. Start a new test only if you accept the possible additional usage.
context.lower: Largest accepted input: {{tokens}} local text tokens
context.maskedHistoryHint: Saved measurement for this masked key. The current credential has not been revalidated.
context.matched: Tokenizer encoding matched; full-request token count may differ.
context.outputLimited: Input accepted; output was truncated at a length limit. This does not invalidate input acceptance.
context.progress: Requests: {{requests}} · Approx. cumulative input budget used: {{tokens}} tokens (including failed requests)

reasons.bracketed: Found an approximate input boundary for this connection.
reasons.budget: This batch reached its request or cumulative input budget. Continue from here to allow more usage.
reasons.inconclusive: The response did not confirm a capacity limit. Retry or open execution details to see the cause.
reasons.test-limit: This input length was accepted. The actual capacity may be larger.
reasons.timeout: The request timed out before input acceptance could be confirmed. A timeout does not prove the input exceeds capacity. Try again later; retrying sends long text again and may use credits.

context.reportedUsage: Reported usage: input {{input}} + output {{output}} = total {{total}} tokens
context.startHint: Sends long text and uses API credits. Pauses at its usage budget.

needle.invalid: Text length must be an integer from 1,024 to 1,048,576; sample ID must be an integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295.
needle.lengthRule: Lengths double from 8K, with a final step at the input limit of {{limit}}.
needle.limitation: A match verifies this sample only. A miss does not prove truncation, a smaller context window or a different model.
needle.matrix: Retrieval by input length and position
needle.matrixHint: Click a status to view details and run or retest that cell. Row and column buttons run every cell in their scope, including previous results. Stop buttons affect only their cell, row or column.
needle.positionRule: Each length is tested at {{positions}}, covering the beginning, middle and end.
needle.quickHint: Run only the three positions at the longest planned length. Other lengths are excluded from this run and can be tested separately by row or column.

reference.unknown: Context limit unavailable. Automatic uses {{tokens}} tokens until a context check provides a new value.

needle.seedHint: Leave blank for a new sample each time. Use the same ID and settings to repeat a sample.
needle.singleLengthRule: This plan tests just one length: {{limit}}.

sources.custom: You set the maximum test input to {{limit}}. This plan uses that limit.
sources.declaredContext: Model metadata lists a {{context}} total context. Reserving {{reserve}} for the reply leaves an input limit of {{input}}. This has not been verified on the current API.

sources.fallback: No usable model limits or accepted-input records are available. This plan uses a default limit of {{limit}}. Adjust it in test settings or check available context first.
sources.measured: Based on input previously accepted by this connection, this plan tests up to {{limit}}. This does not establish the model's maximum capacity.

rules.extraction: When a reference is provided, the model is asked to put its final answer on the last line starting with FINAL_ANSWER:. The text after the colon is extracted. Without a reference, the response is shown without grading.
rules.matching: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed and compatibility characters, such as full-width characters, are normalized before an exact text match. For example, ２１ matches 21, but 21 items does not match 21. Case, punctuation and internal spaces still matter.
rules.privacy: The reference is used locally and is never sent to the model.
rules.title: Comparison rules
rules.unavailable: Without a formatted final answer, a match is accepted only when the entire response matches the reference. Otherwise, the result is “Final answer unclear”. Empty or incomplete responses are reported separately.

questionAnswer.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Your current draft can still be used.
